_readme: The essential repos for a Claude + GPT workflow, checked 2026-09-27. `aos refs` clones them shallow into %LOCALAPPDATA%\agentic-os\refs\<shelf>\<owner>\<name> (outside OneDrive) and pulls on every `aos update`.

use: installed = already wired in through a plugin (clone is for reading) | mine = read and take parts, never install wholesale | read = principles and official reference | catalog = where the next addition comes from | watch = candidate future layer
Rule from the old agent-refs ledger: a repo that produced nothing after a real read is a skip, whatever its star count.

repos.why: Official: Codex review/rescue/transfer from inside Claude Code.
Mirror direction: Claude review/rescue from inside Codex, via the official claude CLI.
Brainstorm > plan > TDD > verify as skills; runs in both agents. Your 2026-07-25 A/B test said adopt.
Agent Skills spec, template and skill-creator: the reference for writing skills.
OpenAI's Codex skills catalog; same SKILL.md format.
Reference MCP servers; read one before writing your own.
Agent SDK and API recipes. ~365 MB of notebooks, so link only.
Largest cross-agent config pack (agents, skills, hooks, rules). Too heavy to install; take single skills or hooks.
100+ subagent definitions. Take 3-5 that fill a real gap.
Four agent-coding principles in one file; already folded into agents-home/AGENTS.md.
Design principles for reliable agents. Highest signal per byte.
Curated cross-agent skills list (Claude Code, Codex, ...).
Index of multi-agent cockpits and orchestrators.
Candidate cockpit: one desktop + phone app for Claude Code and Codex, spawns the official CLIs.
